title: REPLACE: one line naming the mismatch, e.g. 'Cited author disagrees with the frozen record despite a VERIFIED log'
scientific_question: REPLACE: the question the check is meant to serve, stated plainly. For a synthetic entry say that it is illustrative only.
claim_tested: REPLACE: the exact claim about the CHECK (not about the world) that this entry tests.
falsified_by: REPLACE: the observation that would show the claim is false.
data_owner: REPLACE: who owns the data. For synthetic data: 'The corpus maintainers (generated for this corpus). SYNTHETIC: no third-party data and no third-party rights.'
scientific_owner: REPLACE: who is responsible for the scientific intent. For synthetic data: 'The corpus maintainers (generated for this corpus). SYNTHETIC: the scenario is invented and illustrative only and makes no scientific claim; the maintainers answer for the fixture's intent only.'

permissions.granted_by: generated for this corpus; no third-party rights
permissions.notes: REPLACE or keep: keep every flag false except evaluation_allowed unless a real grant exists; with evidence_of_grant NOASSERTION the schema requires that. Evaluation permission never implies training permission.

source_licenses.evidence: REPLACE: e.g. 'generated for this corpus; no license chosen'. List each file separately if their sources differ.

must_mention: REPLACE: the defect name, e.g. AUTHOR_MISMATCH or DOI_WORK_MISMATCH
REPLACE: the citation label as report.md prints it, e.g. citation C2 (10.5555/...)

unresolved_cases: REPLACE: what this entry does not settle.

human_review.reason: REPLACE: e.g. written by one author; needs independent review before it counts as reviewed.

does_not_prove: A pass shows conformance on declared fixtures only: science-gate produced the declared outcome on this entry's synthetic fixtures, with the tool version recorded in environment.lock.
It does not show that science-gate detects this failure in data, layouts or tool versions outside this entry.
It does not establish scientific validity: the data, works, people and sites are invented, so no scientific conclusion is supported or refuted.
It does not show that science-gate, or any pipeline that uses it, is fit for any particular use.
REPLACE or keep: It does not show that any citation outside this entry is correct, or that a live resolver would return what the frozen capture records; no network lookup is performed.

provenance.generator: REPLACE: how the entry's files were produced.
